# evaluation verdict

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`ConditionEvaluation`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md) to carry its single outcome from the [`gmeow:EvaluationVerdict`](../classes/gmeow-EvaluationVerdict.md) vocabulary.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it or giving more than one (it is functional and mandatory by SHACL) and avoid modelling it as [`observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) — it plays that role but stays a separate axiom (QualityValue ⟂ [`Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:evaluationVerdict`](gmeow-evaluationVerdict.md) once per evaluation, paired with [`gmeow:evaluatedCondition`](gmeow-evaluatedCondition.md); the compliance twin uses [`gmeow:complianceVerdict`](gmeow-complianceVerdict.md) over the same vocabulary.
